card.name: Partway through drug names
card.fires_on: Fires on a middle piece of a longer drug or ingredient name, such as the 'up' in buprenorphine or bupivacaine, the 'ate' in enalapril maleate, or the 'oph' in aminophylline. It appears in drug-label text.

modes.label: Middle of drug name
modes.description: A piece inside a drug name that is not yet complete, such as 'up' after b.
modes.example: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION Administer b<<up>>renorphine and naloxone sub

modes.label: End of salt name
modes.description: The 'ate' ending of maleate after an ACE inhibitor name.
modes.example: CONTRAINDICATIONS Enalapril male<<ate>> and hydrochlorothiazide is contr

modes.label: Other ingredient pieces
modes.description: A piece inside another ingredient or Greek-letter term, such as 'or' in castor or 'α' in 5α-reductase.

card.writes: The promoted tokens such as 'agents' suggest it nudges toward agent-like word endings, but the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of a long drug name before the name is finished.
